args.title: Fix README: replace nonexistent npm run serve with npm start
args.body:
File: README.md

In the "Running locally" section, step 5 tells readers to run `npm run build` followed by `npm run serve`, but no `serve` script exists in package.json (the available scripts are start, build, test, and lint). Replace `npm run serve` with `npm start` so the documented steps actually work.
